in_english.long_meaning: Originally an Old English word meaning 'edge,' 'border,' 'angle,' or 'point.' It came to mean 'person from the Englisc (English) people.' The name Eng can be interpreted as 'Edge,' 'Angle,' or 'Person from the English people.'

biblical_reference.verse_reference: Therefore, all the families of the earth shall be blessed through Eng, and his brother shall be called Arpad.
biblical_reference.note: Eng is mentioned as the ancestor of the Anglian tribe, which eventually gave its name to England.

data.cultural_impact: In the early Christian tradition, the name Eng was not widely used. However, in the Middle Ages, it began to be associated with the name Engel, which is derived from the Old English word 'engel', meaning 'angel'. Engel or Engels were believed to be messengers of God, and the name came to symbolize strength, protection, and divine guidance in Christian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Eng holds a deep significance for Christians. It represents the power and energy of God that flows through each believer, empowering them to serve God and spread His message of love and redemption. Eng also symbolizes the protective presence of God, who is always with us, guiding us through life's challenges and trials.
